segments.ja376:1.1: Māsu kujjha bhūmipati, māsu kujjha rathesabha;
segments.ja376:2.1: Gāme vā yadi vāraññe, ninne vā yadi vā thale;
segments.ja376:2.3: Sabbattha anusāsāmi, māsu kujjha [māssu kujjhi (sī. pī.)] rathesabha.
segments.ja376:3.3: Pubbe janaṃ tāretvāna, pacchā yācati vetanaṃ;
segments.ja376:3.5: Tenassa bhaṇḍanaṃ hoti, na ca bhogehi vaḍḍhati.
segments.ja376:4.3: Añño hi tiṇṇassa mano, añño hoti pāresino [taresino (sī. pī.), tiresino (syā.)].
segments.ja376:5.1: Gāme vā yadi vāraññe, ninne vā yadi vā thale;
segments.ja376:7.1: Bhattaṃ bhinnaṃ hatā bhariyā, gabbho ca patito chamā;
segments.ja376:7.3: Migova jātarūpena, na tenatthaṃ abandhi sūti [avaḍḍhitunti (sī. syā.), avaḍḍhi sūti (?)].
